student.title: Student
student.description: For learners who want a steady AI study companion during active courses.
features: Ask Cora about your learning progress and current lessons
Best for dashboard, search, and learning flows

pro.title: Pro
pro.description: For learners who want stronger AI support for faster learning and clearer career direction.
features: Expanded allowance for contextual AI guidance
Career path, profile review, and project direction support
Great for learners juggling multiple tracks

bootcamp.title: Bootcamp
bootcamp.description: For learners who need high-intensity AI support during acceleration phases.
features: Highest allowance for chat, tutor, and discovery
Optimized for goal setting, milestone check-ins, and execution support
Best for cohorts, bootcamps, or career transition phases
